content.title: Braylon Mullins - Men's Basketball - University of Connecticut Athletics
content.text: Braylon Mullins - Men's Basketball - University of Connecticut AthleticsSkip to main contentAll Rotators Playing University of Connecticut Athletics 2025-26 Men's Basketball RosterPosition: GuardHeight: 6-6Weight: 196Class: FreshmanHometown: Greenfield, Ind.Prev School: Greenfield-Central High School: Greenfield-CentralBefore UConn: Indiana-native who played high school basketball at Greenfield-Central…2025 McDonald’s All American…named the 2025 ‘Mr. Basketball’ in the state of Indiana, one of the most prestigious high school honors in America previously won by the likes of Kyle Guy, Gary Harris, Eric Gordon, Sean May, Greg Oden, Tyler and Cody Zeller and more…Gatorade Player of the Year in Indiana…ranked as a consensus five-star prospect, checking in at No. 12 in the 247 Sports rankings, No. 15 on the 247 Composite, No. 15 by On3 and No. 17 on the ESPN100…as a senior, led Greenfield-Central to a 23-4 record and averaged 32.9 points. 7.2 rebounds, 4.2 assists and 3.7 steals per game while shooting over 47 percent from 3-point range…scored 25.0 points with 6.2 rebounds, 3.2 steals and 3.2 assists as a junior for a 24-1 squad…shot 47 percent from three and scored 16.9 points per game as a sophomore on a 21-2 club…Greenfield-Central’s all-time leading scorer with 2,158 points…set the school-record with 52 points on Feb. 23, 2025 – topping his own record of 51 in a game set a season earlier…was named MVP of the Senior All-Star game between prep stars from Indiana and Kentucky, scoring 20 points with nine rebounds and seven assists…played with Indiana Elite 17U on the 3SSB circuit. Personal: Braylon Anthony Mullins…born April 18, 2006…son of Katie and Josh Mullins…has a pair of younger brothers, Cole and Clay.
